method: Mode resampling of 2 m source class to 20 m display cells; polygons below 20000 m² omitted; simplified by 10 m in source projection.
rights: USGS public-domain data; credit USGS and CSU Monterey Bay Seafloor Mapping Lab. Not for navigation.
limitations: Historical video-supervised substrate model; downsampled display polygons omit small patches. Bathymetry's reported vertical reference is instantaneous sea level, so no legal 200-foot depth qualification is inferred. No fish or catch verification.
